plan: OpenVibe.Fun: something to do, alone, together, or live — IRL quests on Live, a local guide from OpenStreetMap (Ticketmaster only with a key), and group plans
summary: OpenVibe.Fun is the Fun room. A streamer opens an IRL quest board on their public Live channel, viewers suggest safe challenges and chat votes with !quest vote, the streamer accepts one and marks it live/completed, and the chat or a moderator verifies it; a local badge is paid and OpenCoins are credited only when the wallet is configured. The local guide reads OpenStreetMap (Nominatim/Overpass with a contact User-Agent, one request a second per host, a seven-day cache and a bounded around: query) and Ticketmaster only when a key is configured. Group plans have options, one vote each, a tie refused, and a winner the viewer can add to their own Today with their own token. No route needs a service token; Fun never posts to Chat or Live.
works: Streamer quest boards tied to a public Live channel, checked against the signed-in Network username
Viewer suggestions with an explainable dangerous/illegal/trespassing/harassment filter, accessible-only boards and suggestion caps
One vote per person per quest and one per public chat username; public counts
Accept, live, complete and verify by a streamer; chat quorum (default 3) or a Network moderator
Local badge always paid on verification; OpenCoins ledger with per-person and global daily caps when FUN_COINS=on
Read-only chat vote ingestion for !quest vote, !quest suggest, !quest verify and !plan vote, idempotent per message id
A deterministic local guide from Nominatim/Overpass with a contact User-Agent, a per-host pacer, a seven-day cache, stale fallback and ODbL attribution
Ticketmaster Discovery events only when TICKETMASTER_API_KEY is set; the key is never cached, returned or logged
Group plans with options, one vote per person, a tie refused, an owner/staff decision and a winner added to the viewer's own Today via the person's token
Search Fabric documents (owner fun; types quest and plan) in fun_outbox, with valid tombstones on hide/cancel
Sign-in with OpenVibe.Network (PKCE S256, fun_at/fun_rt/fun_oauth), staff role global_mod+
Account export and deletion: personal rows erased; public quests/boards and shared plans anonymized, never silently kept with a name
Server-rendered pages with stable fu- ids/classes, a no-JS OBS overlay, discovery artifacts and deploy files
notYet: An AI chat or model-generated guide: v1 is deterministic and adds no AI capability
Ticketmaster events without a key: v1 is OSM-only by default
OpenCoins without the FUN_COINS=on setting and the identity.subject.resolve + network.coins.credit grants: the badge is still paid
The Search document relay: documents wait in fun_outbox until Network grants fun search.document.write
A service-token proof of Live channel ownership: v1 checks the public channel and matching Network username
Fan-out of a decided group plan to every member's Today: each viewer adds it to their own with their own token
Parsing OSM opening_hours into open-now; the guide shows the raw OSM value
Optional tips on a quest: v1 has no payment provider and never moves money
The v2/v3 mosaic, party games, creator quests, city-by-city guide and partnerships
deployment: not deployed: the unit and nginx vhost are deploy/systemd/openvibe-fun.service and deploy/nginx/openvibe.fun.conf
